title: How should a request choose between Genesis, Adoption and update?
question: How should a request choose between Genesis, Adoption and update?
answer: V3-4: /genesis creates a greenfield Workbench, /adoption migrates an unmanaged existing project once, and /update-harness upgrades an already-adopted project; "none substitutes for another".
